articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has received two multi-million-dollar contracts from TKMS to provide mast-raising equipment and associated electronic control units. The L3Harris technology will enable submarines to deploy and retract critical payloads used for communications, surveillance and navigation.
articles.title: L3Harris to Advance German and Norwegian Submarine Technology

articles.summary: L3Harris is helping define the next era of digital electronic support measures (ESMs) with ReconneX™, an ESM and electronic warfare system built to give operators faster, more integrated awareness across the electromagnetic environment.
articles.title: ReconneX™ Defines the Next Era of Digital Electronic Support Measures

articles.summary: From exquisite kinetic effectors to sense-and-protect software, the L3Harris portfolio of counter-unmanned aerial system solutions provides force protection against a wide array of threats.
articles.title: A Layered Approach to Drone-Threat Protection

articles.summary: Panther™ II man-portable tactical SATCOM terminal and Comtech 5650C2/MP modem are now the industry’s only embeddable devices certified for SES’s O3b mPOWER Sovereign and Wideband Global SATCOM (WGS) constellations.
articles.title: Sovereign, Resilient and Ready - the Next Era of SATCOM

articles.summary: Palantir's $53 million production award to L3Harris moves the Army's most advanced intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) ground station from rapid prototyping to rapid fielding for the warfighter.
articles.title: TITAN: Cutting-Edge ISR, Delivered Fast

articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has received multiple production orders in support of the U.S. Army, with a combined value of $121 million, for a Low-Cost Data Radio (LOCODA) solution to assist Army Command and Control requirements.
articles.title: L3Harris Receives $121 Million in Orders to Support Army Command and Control
